import os
import sys
import argparse

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Rename files in a folder")
    parser.add_argument("folder")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    for index, name in enumerate(sorted(os.listdir(args.folder))):
        print(f"{index}: {name}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
-----
import json
import requests

def fetch_status(url, timeout=10):
    response = requests.get(url, timeout=timeout)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()

data = fetch_status("https://api.example.com/v1/status")
print(json.dumps(data, indent=2))
-----
class Inventory:
    def __init__(self):
        self.items = {}

    def add(self, name, quantity):
        self.items[name] = self.items.get(name, 0) + quantity

    def total(self):
        return sum(self.items.values())
-----
with open("report.csv") as handle:
    rows = [line.strip().split(",") for line in handle if line.strip()]
header, body = rows[0], rows[1:]
print(len(body), "rows with columns", ", ".join(header))

import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
print("current commit:", result.stdout.strip())
